specification.title: Sesh Runtime Integration Boundary
purpose: Define the first server-runtime integration boundary between the live Cloudflare Sesh persistence resources and application-facing Sesh runtime code.
Preserve the existing provider-neutral Sesh domain and persistence contracts.
Prevent premature public mutation endpoints before creator identity and ownership authorization are explicitly defined.

cloudflareRuntimeAccess.decision: Sesh server runtime integration will use the existing cloudflare:workers env convention rather than introduce a second runtime-binding mechanism.

dynamicServerRoutes.decision: Any future Sesh API or action route requiring D1 or R2 must be server-rendered and must not be prerendered.

responseCaching.decision: Authenticated or creator-specific Sesh runtime responses must default to no-store unless a later specification explicitly permits caching.

sameOriginWrites.existingExample: River CRM write actions use same-origin request validation.
sameOriginWrites.decision: Same-origin validation may be reused as CSRF-oriented defense in depth, but it MUST NOT be treated as creator authentication or project ownership authorization.

runtimeComposition.selectedDesign: Introduce one narrow server-only Sesh runtime composition helper.
responsibilities: Read SESH_DB and SESH_AUDIO from the Cloudflare worker environment.
Validate that both bindings are present.
Return the existing projectRepository, audioAssetRepository, and audioObjectStore.
Contain provider-specific environment access at the server boundary.
mustNot: Duplicate D1 or R2 adapter logic.
Import Cloudflare runtime globals into provider-neutral Sesh domain modules.
runtimeComposition.publicExportPolicy: The runtime helper may be exported from a Sesh server-only runtime module but MUST NOT be re-exported from browser-safe Sesh entrypoints.

identityAndAuthorizationBoundary.governingPrinciple: Authentication identity, Sesh creator profile, and CRM Person are distinct concepts.
identityAndAuthorizationBoundary.creatorProfileRule: SeshCreatorProfile MUST NOT become the authentication record or duplicate legal/account identity.
identityAndAuthorizationBoundary.ownershipRule: A caller MUST NOT gain access to a SeshMusicProject merely by knowing a project identifier.
identityAndAuthorizationBoundary.currentState: The repository discovery did not establish a canonical authenticated creator-to-SeshCreatorId mapping suitable for project authorization.
identityAndAuthorizationBoundary.consequence: SESH-009 MUST NOT introduce externally reachable creator-owned mutation endpoints.
requiredFutureBoundary: Resolve the authenticated account or session identity.
Resolve that identity to exactly one authorized SeshCreatorId or an explicitly permitted set.
Verify ownerCreatorId or a future explicit collaborator permission.
Reject unauthorized access before exposing project metadata or audio objects.
forbiddenShortcuts: Trusting creatorId supplied by request body.
Trusting ownerCreatorId supplied by request body.
Using CRM Person as Sesh creator identity without an explicit mapping specification.
Creating implicit ownership from email address, display name, cookie text, route parameter, or project identifier.

implementationAllowed: Unit tests using fake env bindings.
Non-mutating internal verification code that does not expose creator data publicly.
implementationDeferred: Publishing, management, label, royalty, ownership, or rights workflows.

futureApiShape.note: These paths reserve conceptual organization only. Their methods, payloads, authorization model, and exposure are not approved by this specification.

audioBoundary.separationRule: Binary audio bytes must remain separate from metadata persistence.
audioBoundary.accessRule: Possession of an R2 storage reference MUST NOT itself authorize object retrieval.
audioBoundary.deletionRule: Metadata deletion and binary object deletion remain separate explicit operations.

rightsAndLaunchBoundary.rule: Runtime persistence or product usage must never silently establish music ownership, publishing, management, label, royalty, licensing, representation, or revenue-share rights.
rightsAndLaunchBoundary.launch: Sesh Launch remains downstream and optional.
rightsAndLaunchBoundary.futureRightsActions: Any action creating or transferring rights requires an explicit separately modeled agreement or rights workflow.

errorAndResponsePolicy.bindingUnavailable: Server runtime should fail closed with a service-unavailable class response or typed server error.
errorAndResponsePolicy.malformedInput: Future request adapters must validate input before passing it into persistence.
errorAndResponsePolicy.notFound: Not-found behavior must not leak unauthorized resource existence where authorization semantics require concealment.
errorAndResponsePolicy.storageFailure: Persistence/storage failures must not expose provider credentials, raw SQL, internal bucket keys beyond intentionally opaque references, or stack traces to clients.

testRequirements: Runtime helper composes the existing D1 project repository, D1 audio metadata repository, and R2 object store.
Tests use fakeable narrow contracts and no live Cloudflare resources.
No provider-specific runtime access leaks into src/lib/sesh/model.ts, validation.ts, identifiers.ts, or other provider-neutral domain modules.

implementationSequence.name: Server runtime composition
implementationSequence.outcome: Create and test the narrow Cloudflare env-to-Sesh-persistence composition helper.

implementationSequence.name: Authenticated creator identity boundary
implementationSequence.outcome: Specify the canonical mapping from authenticated account/session identity to SeshCreatorId without duplicating auth or CRM identity.

implementationSequence.name: Project authorization service
implementationSequence.outcome: Enforce owner/collaborator authorization independently of HTTP routes.

implementationSequence.name: Project API
implementationSequence.outcome: Expose authenticated project operations through validated server routes.

implementationSequence.name: Audio transfer API
implementationSequence.outcome: Expose authorized upload/download lifecycle using private application-mediated R2 access.

acceptanceCriteria: The specification preserves SESH-001 through SESH-008 boundaries.
Cloudflare runtime access follows the repository's existing cloudflare:workers env convention.
The existing createSeshCloudflarePersistence composition remains the only production adapter composition mechanism.
No public creator-owned mutation API is authorized before authenticated creator ownership mapping exists.
Same-origin validation is explicitly classified as insufficient for creator authorization.
Sesh creator identity remains distinct from authentication identity and CRM Person.
D1 metadata and R2 binary audio remain separated.
No implicit music-rights semantics are introduced.
The next implementation slice can be tested entirely without live Cloudflare mutations.
nonGoals: Creating a DAW or sequencer interface.
Implementing Studio, Rhythm, Keys, Control, Pulse, Sounds, or Launch product UX.
